max_tire.note: IH8MUD FAQ answer. 295/75R16 fits with 1/2 to 1 inch of clearance at full lock, which is tight; one owner measured 3/4 inch to the rear plastic liner on 285/75s.
Needs a little trimming and the pinch-weld fold. You may have to remove the washer-bottle cover or move the bottle, and owners add extended front bump stops.
Fits, but rubs the plastic liner up front and the rear sheet metal at full compression. Owners adjust turn stops and bump stops, and some add a mild body lift to keep full travel.

items.title: Side curtain airbag inadvertent deployment
items.summary: The airbag control module may be programmed wrong, so the side curtain airbags can deploy unexpectedly; shared with the LX 470, 4Runner, GX 470, Tundra and Sequoia.

items.title: Missing load-capacity modification label
items.summary: Paperwork-only recalls under FMVSS 110 (tire selection and rims): some trucks were sold without the label showing reduced load capacity after accessories were added. 10V036000 covers Southeast Toyota distributor vehicles; 09V223000 covers certain 2005-on Toyota vehicles.

tsbs.title: Exhaust booming at idle
tsbs.summary: Booming after warm-up on 1998–2006 LC/LX; the fixes include a frame-mounted crossmember damper weight.

tsbs.title: Transfer case buzz
tsbs.summary: Buzz under light or moderate acceleration; Toyota revised the high-speed output gear, shift linkage and centre diff case.

tsbs.title: Front brake vibration
tsbs.summary: Bulletin for pulsing or vibrating front brakes on 1998-on trucks.

tsbs.title: Continuous alarm noise from the combination meter
tsbs.summary: Loud constant buzzer from the gauge cluster.

tsbs.title: A/C expansion valve noise
tsbs.summary: Groaning from the A/C expansion valve on early 1999 builds within a stated VIN range.

timeline.change: UZJ100 launches in the US with the 4.7 L 2UZ-FE V8, the only US engine. It's the first Land Cruiser with independent front suspension and the first with a V8
Selectable rear diff locker offered as an option, and only in these two model years. Off-roaders still hunt for them, but they come with the weaker front diff below
Two-pinion front differential. It's the most common source of front-diff failures when the truck is driven hard
Four-pinion front diff fitted from late 1999 production (model year 2000) with fewer reported failures; 50th Anniversary commemorative models in several countries

Five-speed A750F automatic replaces the four-speed, with a no-contact throttle sensor; the late (2006–07) trucks add the VVT-i 2UZ-FE. These are the years owners most often point buyers to, and some say the five-speed matters more than the extra VVT-i power
Model years covered by the side curtain airbag recall (16V065000)
Last model year; production ends in August 2007

identify.intro: In the US, every 100 is a V8 UZJ100 or its Lexus LX 470 twin. The solid-axle 105 and the diesels were never sold here, but they're now arriving as 25-year imports.

items.head: 100 vs 105
items.body: The 105 kept the 80 Series' solid front axle and straight-six engines and was sold in Africa, Australia, Russia and South America. Tells: the IFS 100 often sits nose-low, and 100s wear almost flat-faced wheels where 105s have dished ones.

items.head: Model codes
items.body: UZJ100 = 2UZ-FE 4.7 V8 (US). FZJ100/105 = 1FZ-FE 4.5 straight-six. HZJ105 = 1HZ diesel. HDJ100 = 1HD-T or 1HD-FTE turbo-diesel. Anything other than a UZJ100 in the US is an import.

items.head: Factory rear locker
items.body: The selectable rear locker was an option on 1998–1999 trucks only. A later truck with a rear locker has an aftermarket one.

items.head: Front diff
items.body: 1998–1999 trucks (built mid-1997 to mid-1999) came with the weaker 2-pinion front diff; model year 2000 onward got the 4-pinion unit.

items.head: VIN
items.body: Toyota's own bulletins quote US UZJ100 VIN ranges beginning JT3HT05J. As on any US VIN, the 10th character is the model year (X = 1999, Y = 2000).

values.intro: Rough 100s are still cheap, but clean, low-mileage, well-documented trucks now sell for 80-Series money.
values.note: Based on 20 Bring a Trailer UZJ100 sales, August–October 2026: $6,350 for a 1999 up to $65,000 for a 37,000-mile 1999. Gray-import FZJ105s were bid to $32.5k–42.5k without selling.

paragraphs: The solid-axle 105 (FZJ105, HZJ105) and diesel 100s (HDJ100) were never sold in the US. Production started in January 1998, so these trucks are reaching the 25-year NHTSA exemption one build year at a time, and Australian-market 105s are already appearing at US auctions.

Federal eligibility doesn't settle registration everywhere. California's smog rules make registering an overseas classic difficult, so check your state's titling and emissions rules before you buy a 105 or a diesel.

production.intro: The 100 was built from January 1998 to August 2007, replacing the 80 and sharing its body with the Lexus LX 470.
